root_cause: The API checks that a user is authenticated but does not verify ownership or authorization for the requested object.
preconditions: A test object owned by the second identity
reproduction_summary: In an authorized lab, compare access to the same synthetic object using two separately provisioned test identities.
evidence_summary: The source write-up describes an authenticated request returning an object belonging to another test identity.
impact: Unauthorized read or modification of another tenant's object, depending on the affected operation.
remediation: Enforce object-level authorization server-side on every request and test tenant boundaries.
false_positives: The object may intentionally be shared
The test identities may belong to the same authorized tenant
source_spans: Sections describing the authorization check and observed response
